Explain how to make a clay rose.
Start by rolling out a piece of clay into a flat sheet.
Use a rolling pin to flatten the clay further.
Use a knife or sculpting tool to cut the clay into petal shapes.
Roll the petals into a spiral shape to form the rose.
Use a small tool to create indentations in the petals for texture.
Assemble the petals around a central stem, shaping them to resemble a rose.
Add leaves and other details as desired.
Use a mold to imprint patterns onto the petals, adding depth and realism to the rose.
